expiry: active on placement/attack round and next round; expire after final next-round turn-end effects before following round

mine.damage: 25+target canonical enemy core level; DEF ignored; percentage mitigation applies
mine.mov: -1, same-mine type non-additive, refresh until affected target next own-turn end
mine.consume: one enemy per mine, immediate removal on detonation
mine.overlap: partial sensor overlap allowed; all matching mines resolve in deterministic placement/member order

interference.effect: enemy MOV-1 within field, minimum1; same type non-additive

fire.center: living enemy, normal equipped blast range/LOS
fire.limit: once per enemy per Core actor turn across all active fire zones
fire.normalBlastOrDoubleDetonationModifiers: independent special action; no automatic co-activation

stateCompatibility: optional additive Core v1 state; legacy omissions are empty; CAS/action receipts retained
scope: M01/M02 standalone offline; no CAP/acquisition/stats/reward changes; no merge/deploy
